changes.title: First release
changes.summary: Law firms (NAICS 541110) by employment size for the US, every state and DC from the Census Bureau's Statistics of U.S. Businesses 2022, nonemployer (solo) legal-services businesses from Nonemployer Statistics 2024, and firms, receipts and concentration from the Economic Census 2022. Classes the Census Bureau does not publish are left empty and marked suppressed.
